messages.message:
According to the fictional Northaven policy, faulty or damaged items are covered for 12 months. You can get a replacement or refund, and Northaven pays the return postage. Please photograph the damage before packing the thermometer for return. To start the process, email returns@northaven-instruments.example with your order reference and a brief description of the issue. You will receive a returns number and label within one working day.

Is there anything else I can help with regarding your order?
